evidence.content: Released process routing defines P10 incoming material verification, P20 rivet assembly, P30 final inspection and pack, including sequence P10 -> P20 -> P30.
Drawing and engineering requirements define material thickness 2.00 +/- 0.10 mm, rivet height 1.50 +0.50/-0.00 mm, and push-out force >= 10 kN.
Incoming quality uses supplier CoC, drawing revision check, and digital thickness gauge measurement per lot for purchased bracket and pin verification.
Rivet assembly setup uses press setup verification, first-off approval, locked press adjustment, and go/no-go rivet height gauge every 30 minutes.
Push-out force is verified by destructive push-out test once per shift with traceable record and containment reaction when force is below requirement.

evidence.source: pack specification and barcode scan record
evidence.content: Final inspection verifies released revision, readable traceability barcode, pack quantity, and requires barcode scan before pack close.
